messages.subject: Prob of ancetral range
parts:
Hello Nick, how are you?

I was discussing some of the probabilities of ancestral ranges with a colleague and we got into a point that we are not sure of.Say we have our biogeobears results and when we plot the discrete range for the node, we get A.

If we plot with the piechart probabilities, we see A around 60%, B around 30% and C around 10%.

I think it is safe to say that that node has a probability of 60% of having area A as the ancestral range, and so on, right?

However, what is the probability of the range being AB? is it just probability of A x prob. of B? Or something else should be considered? Or there is no way of knowing?

Thank you
